name: limit-direct
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: distinct-direct
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: limit-id-function
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS x LIMIT 1

name: distinct-id-function
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT id(n) AS x LIMIT 1

name: limit-throw-projection
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN substring(n.caller_name,'bad') AS x LIMIT 1

name: where-no-hit
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'absent' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: where-graph-scope
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND n.graphId='a' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: distinct-graph
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x,n.graphId AS graph LIMIT 1
